card.name: Last word before an exclamation mark
card.fires_on: The final word of an enthusiastic or exclamatory phrase, right where an exclamation mark is expected next. Mostly upbeat, informal web text such as school, volunteer and contest announcements.

modes.label: Cheerful announcements
modes.description: The closing word of a friendly call to action or congratulation, just before the exclamation mark.
modes.example: Become an Orca Bowl<< Volunteer>>! Please join us for Orca Bowl

modes.label: Quoted shouts and exclamations
modes.description: The last word of a chant, slogan or exclamatory remark that will end in an exclamation mark.

card.writes: It boosts exclamation marks and their variants as the next character, and suppresses other symbols.
card.plain: It notices a cheerful or shouted phrase that is about to end and predicts an exclamation mark.
